seo.title: Lunch at OSH Del Mar — Terrace Dining Above the Marina, JBR
seo.description: Four courses for 150 AED, or 20% off à la carte. Daily 2–6 PM on the M-floor terrace at Address Beach Resort. Free valet. Request your table in 30 seconds.

form.heading: Request your table
form.sub: Two steps, 30 seconds. We confirm on WhatsApp.

date.label: Date
date.todayClosed: Today's last seating has passed — tomorrow?

step2.heading: Where should we confirm?

phone.label: WhatsApp number
phone.helper: This is where the confirmation goes.

notes.label: Anything we should know?
notes.placeholder: Birthday, a table by the terrace rail, a high chair…

step2.microcopy: No prepayment. We'll confirm on WhatsApp within 15 minutes — or first thing in the morning if it's after 11 PM.
step2.consentNote: By requesting a table you agree to be contacted on WhatsApp about this reservation.

errors.nameRequired: We'll need a name for the table.
errors.phoneRequired: We confirm on WhatsApp, so we need a number.
errors.phoneInvalid: That number doesn't look right. Include the country code, like +971 50 123 4567.
errors.guestsInvalid: Guests: a number from 1 to 20. For bigger groups, message us on WhatsApp.
errors.offerRequired: Pick one of the two lunch options.
errors.slotUnavailable: That slot is full. The closest we have is {{ALT_TIME}} — or try another day.
errors.network: That didn't go through. Check your connection and try again — everything you typed is still here.
errors.server: Something broke on our side. Message the host on WhatsApp and they'll sort it out right now.
errors.timePassed: That time has already passed today. Pick a later slot, or tomorrow.

whatsappBlock.heading: Something unusual?
whatsappBlock.body: A table for twelve, a birthday, a question about the terrace — talk to the host directly.
whatsappBlock.prefilledMessage: Hi OSH Del Mar — I'd like to ask about a lunch table.

thanks.h1: Got it. The host is checking your table.
steps: The host checks availability for that time.
You get a WhatsApp message confirming it — usually within 15 minutes.
Come to the M floor at Address Beach Resort. Valet is free.
thanks.ctaMicrocopy: Nothing has been charged. If plans change, just reply in that chat.
thanks.instagram: Want to see what the terrace looks like tonight? @oshdubai
